name: Iterative Reconstruction with Basis Expansion
definition: A method modeling attenuation as a linear combination of non-negative basis functions to solve the inverse problem when filtered backprojection fails due to inconsistencies or limited angles.
summary: Iterative Reconstruction with Basis Expansion models attenuation as a linear combination of non-negative basis functions to solve the inverse problem when filtered backprojection fails due to inconsistent projections or limited viewing angles.
